name: decide
description: Reach a decision with fresh agents, or with the user. vote: independent proposers and blind voters pick among discrete options, with plurality, Borda and Condorcet tallies. improve: a chain of challengers, each asking "is there a better way to do this?" and keeping or improving a proposal. bakeoff: unanchored brainstorm, distinct solution families, prototype, red-team, repair, blind judge. docket: present the user one decision at a time, each with the context needed to decide.
